## Checklist

- [ ] Both platforms: the change lands in Svelte and in Flutter, or there is a reason it does not.
- [ ] `DESIGN.md` says what the components now do.
- [ ] Tests cover it; a fix has a test that fails without it.
- [ ] `npm run build` leaves no generated file out of date.
- [ ] Commits have a conventional title (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`…).
